subject: Onboarding: BlueHarbor Logistics (PL) — tax IDs, PO and invoice guidance
messages:
From: Anna Kowalska <anna.k@blueharbor.pl>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Onboarding: BlueHarbor Logistics (PL) — initial tax docs and questions

Hi Priyom and Redwood procurement team,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. As discussed, attaching our Polish tax evidence for vendor setup: NIP certificate and company registration page. A couple of points we need to confirm so we can align our billing:

- Which Redwood legal entity will issue the PO? Our finance needs the exact billing entity + VAT number to decide whether VAT should be charged or reverse-charged.
- PO currency: can Redwood accept EUR on POs issued from your EU entity? We typically invoice in PLN or EUR depending on client entity.
- On invoices where reverse-charge applies, do you want us to leave the VAT line empty or add a note referencing reverse-charge (Art. 28b)?
- Bank details: should we send our Polish IBAN/SWIFT, or will Redwood use a local payout partner that requires additional payee data?

Attachments: NIP_certificate_PL_2027.pdf (tax id), company_registration_PL.pdf (KRS excerpt).

Please let us know the PO instructions and any invoice template you prefer. We want to avoid rework on the first invoice.

Best,
Anna Kowalska
Head of Finance
BlueHarbor Logistics
anna.k@blueharbor.pl | +48 602 123 456

---
Attachment stubs: NIP_certificate_PL_2027.pdf (pdf), company_registration_PL.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anna Kowalska <anna.k@blueharbor.pl>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 14:20:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Onboarding: BlueHarbor Logistics (PL) — initial tax docs and questions

Hi Anna — thanks for sending these over and for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (tax/compliance) and Vivek (account lead) to confirm the EU billing flow. Quick answers while they review the attachments: 

- PO entity: Redwood will be issuing POs from "Redwood Inference Europe Ltd" for EU contracts by default. I will confirm the exact VAT number below once Karthik verifies.
- Currency: We can accept EUR on the PO; we will send POs in EUR. If you invoice in PLN, we may need to split allocation across cost centers — EUR is preferable to avoid FX reconciliation.
- Reverse charge: We typically expect non-US suppliers to issue invoices without charging VAT when the goods/services are supplied to our EU entity and the vendor is registered in the EU — include your NIP on the invoice and add an explicit line: "VAT reverse charge — Article 194/2006 (Poland/EU) applies". Karthik will confirm the exact phrasing.
- Bank details: Send your IBAN/SWIFT as you suggested. If we require additional beneficiary confirmation for high-value payments we'll let you know.

Karthik — can you confirm the exact VAT ID to use on Redwood's side and whether we need a tax representative on file for BlueHarbor? Also, Ben, FYI on the preferred invoicing currency and PO terms.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood-inference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anna Kowalska <anna.k@blueharbor.pl>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: BlueHarbor Logistics (PL) — tax IDs, PO and invoice guidance

Hi Anna — thanks for the documents and the suggested reverse-charge wording. Confirming here from tax/compliance: 

- Redwood Inference Europe Ltd — VAT ID: PL999999999 (please use this on the PO and on your invoice references).
- Invoice treatment: Issue invoice without VAT and include the line: "Reverse charge — Article 193 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC applies". Also include your NIP and company registration number. That fulfils our tax evidence requirements.
- PO format: please reference the PO in the header as: "PO: RDW-EU-<6-digit-number>" (we'll send the formal PO with that number).
- Currency: We'll send POs in EUR; invoice in EUR preferred. If you must invoice in PLN include the EUR equivalent and the FX rate on the invoice.
- Payments: include IBAN and SWIFT. We will pay to the bank details you provided; high-value payments may need beneficiary verification via our payments team (we'll notify if required).
- Tax representative: not required for standard cross-border services in this case, but retain local tax advisor contact (Patricia) in case of audits.

I've attached a short sample invoice template (redwood_sample_invoice_template.xlsx) showing required fields (VAT lines left blank for reverse-charge). If you can prepare the first invoice using that template we'll be able to process quickly.

Next steps: Priyom will issue the PO by EOD Monday with the RDW-EU number; Anna to return the first invoice referencing that PO and using the template.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Tax & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
